sources.title: RNP PoP-SC Florianópolis — official facility information

facts.label: Facility overview
facts.value: RNP’s Santa Catarina point of presence operates from SeTIC at UFSC. Its dedicated equipment area supports academic backbone, metropolitan network and exchange connectivity.

facts.label: Specification scope
facts.value: Electrical ratings describe SeTIC data-centre infrastructure shared by this hosted PoP; they are not an exclusive RNP allocation.

facts.label: UPS configuration
facts.value: 150 kVA rated system, configured for 90 kVA load with two hot-spare modules; stated battery autonomy 7 minutes

facts.label: Alternative UPS configuration
facts.value: 120 kVA with one hot-spare module; a possible reconfiguration, not additional simultaneous capacity

facts.label: Standby generation
facts.value: 170 kVA; 250-litre diesel tank with stated 6-hour autonomy

facts.label: Cooling
facts.value: Climate-controlled equipment room; no redundancy rating disclosed

facts.label: Access control
facts.value: Controlled access to the dedicated equipment area

facts.label: Network infrastructure
facts.value: RNP backbone, REMEP-FLN and IX.br equipment; CAT6 cabling and dedicated carrier-entry racks

facts.label: Published address
facts.value: SeTIC / UFSC, Centro Tecnológico, Campus Universitário Trindade, Florianópolis 88040-900, Brazil
